lead.body: The three leaders met in Shenzhen on the sidelines of the APEC summit, with Ukraine, Iran and nuclear arms on the table. Xi greeted Trump at the airport; Beijing billed the meeting as having groundbreaking significance.
lead.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first-ever trilateral summit

sources_note: Researched from AP, AFP, Reuters, The Japan Times, The Hindu, NDTV, Manila Times, SBS — events that happened or were first reported on 19 Nov 2026.

stories.body: Grand Theft Auto VI began its global rollout to near-perfect reviews, ending a 13-year wait for the blockbuster's return to Vice City.
stories.headline: GTA VI launches worldwide to near-perfect reviews

stories.body: Anthropic's market debut raised $107.3 billion, topping SpaceX's record IPO, as investors piled into the AI lab behind Claude.
stories.headline: Anthropic IPO raises $107.3bn, a record debut

stories.body: US defence secretary Pete Hegseth made a surprise trip to Venezuela and signed a deal to re-establish military ties, from training to intelligence sharing.
stories.headline: Hegseth inks US–Venezuela defence pact

stories.body: A Van Gogh painting sold for a record $190.4 million at auction, settling a long-running ownership dispute.
stories.headline: Van Gogh sells for record $190.4m

stories.body: Clashes between Ethiopia and Eritrea threatened to escalate into full-scale war, alarming neighbours and aid agencies.
stories.headline: Ethiopia–Eritrea clashes risk full-scale war

stories.body: Three oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines east of the Strait of Hormuz. The World Court rules today on Myanmar's alleged Rohingya genocide.
stories.headline: Tankers burn off Hormuz; court rules on Rohingya
